conventions: Book bps are stated as nominal (strategy_config source) and effective (nominal x GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER 1.5 x STRATEGY_BASE_TILT), on the flat $750k ACCOUNT_VALUE basis, not live NLV. The per-strategy daily cap is 250 bps effective of staged risk. Sleeves are sized in percent of NAV notional and are not GRM-scaled. An order_ref_tags value ending in * matches by prefix on the orderRef strategy field.

strategies.name: 52wh Breakout
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks and ETFs (LIQUID_UNIVERSE), plus the overflow small/mid-cap tier
strategies.captures: Momentum continuation after a fresh 52-week high that is also an all-time high, on a volume surge, in names that are strong but not already at the top of their one-year range. The calm-regime gate keeps it from buying breakouts into volatile chop, where breakouts fail more often.
strategies.entry: Persistent GTC limit at signal close - 0.25 ATR, live for 10 trading days (moved from -0.5 ATR on 2026-07-07). Filters: 252d rank 50-90, new 52-week high that is also an all-time high, volume above 2.5x the 63d average, market above its 200d SMA, 63d dial (10d average) below 30.
strategies.exit: 2.0 ATR stop (arms the session after entry), 8.0 ATR target, or a 63 trading-day time stop, whichever comes first.
strategies.sizing: 35 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 0.70 = 36.75 bps effective per trade. No fragility band. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day effective.
strategies.risk_controls: Hard stop, calm-regime entry gate, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Source of truth is strategy_config.py (no dedicated reference doc). Live since is approximate: the systematic book went live in the Primary account around June 2026. The ledger replays today's config over all history.

strategies.name: Weak Close Decent Sznls
strategies.instruments: US index and sector ETFs
strategies.captures: A weak close in index and sector ETFs that have held above their 20d and 50d SMAs for 10 sessions, during a window where the 5-day ATR seasonal rank is high. The bet is a two-day mean reversion of a one-day pullback inside an established uptrend.
strategies.entry: Limit at the T+1 open - 0.25 ATR. Filters: 2d rank 5-50, 5d rank under 50, 5d ATR seasonal rank above 65, close above the 20d and 50d SMA for 10 straight sessions, close in the bottom 15% of the day's range.
strategies.exit: 1.0 ATR stop (arms day 2), 2.0 ATR target, or a 2 trading-day time stop.
strategies.sizing: 35 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 0.75 = 39.4 bps effective. FAMILY4 fragility band on the 10d-MA 63d dial, with the table picked by the P/C fear state: fear ON gives 1.25x below 50 and 1.0x at 50+, fear OFF gives 1.0x below 50 and 0x at 50+, and a stale or missing P/C reading (older than 3 business days) fails closed to the plain band of 0.25x at 50+. The seasonal-rank size tiers were retired 2026-09-04. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Hard stop, fragility band with the P/C fear table, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.name: Oversold Low Volume
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks, commodity ETFs, plus the overflow small/mid-cap tier
strategies.captures: Buys names in a long-term uptrend (252d rank 50-90) that have become short-term oversold on low volume while SPY is above its 200d SMA. Low-volume weakness reads as an absence of sellers rather than distribution, so the pullback tends to revert over the next two weeks.
strategies.entry: Persistent close-anchored limit, normally signal close - 0.25 ATR, live T+1 to T+3. Retests of a prior pivot high use deeper limits: -0.50 ATR when 2-4 ATR above the nearest confirmed 40/40 closing pivot high (sources no older than 252 sessions), -0.75 ATR at 4-5 ATR, no order above 5 ATR. Minimum 5 years of history.
strategies.exit: 2.5 ATR target above the submitted limit, a 10 trading-day time stop, or the volume-confirmed stop. There is no resting stop order: if a session closes at or below entry - 1.25 ATR on volume at least 1.5x the trailing 20d median, the leg exits market-on-open the next morning (olv_exit_moo.py, both accounts). Quiet closes below the level are held.
strategies.sizing: Liquid tier 35 bps nominal = 52.5 effective; overflow tier 25 nominal = 37.5 effective. Signal-recency ladder: the first signal in the ticker's trailing 21 sessions sizes 0.5x, the second 0.7x, the third and later 1.0x. Signals 10 to 0 trading days before earnings size at 10 nominal = 15 effective, still times the ladder rung. Stacked legs in one single stock are capped at 50% of NAV in entry notional (ETFs exempt). No fragility band since 2026-08-25. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Volume-confirmed next-open exit, 10-day time exit, per-ticker 50% NAV notional cap, recency ladder, earnings size override, per-strategy daily cap. No overnight stop, so a single leg can lose 2-3R.
strategies.notes: Universe size counts the liquid list only; the overflow tier adds several hundred names. The ledger replays today's sizing over all history, so OLV legs entered before 2026-07-29 were 1.15x-2.85x larger live than the ledger shows (no ladder then); per-trade R is unaffected. Overflow-tier backtest stats carry survivorship bias. Sector loss gate retired 2026-07-20.

strategies.name: Overbot Vol Spike
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks and commodity ETFs, plus the overflow tier
strategies.captures: Shorts names that are overbought on every horizon from 2 to 21 days and then gap up again at the next open. The gap is the blow-off, and the position harvests the two-day reversal. A 252d barbell skips mediocre long-term names (rank 65-95) and a 5d seasonal gate skips strong seasonal windows.
strategies.entry: Limit short at T+1 open + 0.75 ATR. Two paths decided by order_staging at the IBKR open: an open above signal close + 0.25 ATR is path 1 (full size), an open between the close and close + 0.25 ATR is path 2 (small size), an open at or below the close is skipped. Earnings blackout of 10 trading days either side. When ATR Extended Gap Up fires on the same symbol and passes its gate, the OVS row is dropped.
strategies.exit: No stop. 2 trading-day time exit. The Primary account splits each entry into two brackets: 40% of shares with a 1 ATR target and 60% with a 2 ATR target (PA is not split). Friday entries exit at the close if more than 0.25 ATR offside at 15:58.
strategies.sizing: Path 1: 40 bps nominal = 60 effective. Path 2: 8 nominal = 12 effective, with an aggregate daily cap on path-2 risk of 0.75% nominal (1.125% effective). Midterm years, 2026 included, run 0.75x. No fragility band, tilt 1.0. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Two-path open gate, earnings blackout, Friday entry-day drawdown exit, scale-out, midterm 0.75x, path-2 aggregate cap, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: The engine books the scale-out as two tranche rows per fill; the ledger stats here count one position per ticker, signal and entry date, with tranche R share-weighted. The scale-out is variance smoothing and costs some R by design.

strategies.name: LT Trend ST OS
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks and commodity ETFs, plus the overflow tier
strategies.captures: One-day oversold bounce in persistent uptrends. Every horizon from 2 to 21 days sits in the bottom 15%, the day is a decisive red bar closing near its low, and the name has held above its 100d SMA for 20+ sessions and its 200d for 50+, without being an extreme leader (252d rank 65-90).
strategies.entry: Persistent GTC limit at signal close - 0.25 ATR. Earnings blackout of 10 trading days either side. Minimum 5 years of history.
strategies.exit: No stop. 2.0 ATR target or a 1 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 30 bps nominal = 45 effective. No fragility band. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: One-day clock, earnings blackout, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Source of truth is strategy_config.py. Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.name: St OS Sznl
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks and commodity ETFs, plus the overflow tier
strategies.captures: Short-term oversold bounce in long-term uptrenders that are not leaders, taken only in top-decile seasonal windows (5d ATR seasonal rank above 90). The seasonal tailwind is the reason to expect the bounce within a week.
strategies.entry: Persistent limit at signal close - 0.25 ATR. Filters: 2/5/10/21d ranks under 15, 252d rank 50-90, 10d volume rank under 65, close in the bottom 25% of the range, 63d dial (10d average) under 65.
strategies.exit: No stop. 1.5 ATR target or a 5 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 40 bps nominal = 60 effective. Signals 5 to 1 trading days before earnings size at 6 nominal = 9 effective. No fragility band. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Five-day clock, dial entry gate, earnings size haircut, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.name: 3x ETF Overbot Fade
strategies.instruments: 3x leveraged ETFs, excluding bear-equity names
strategies.captures: Shorts 3x leveraged ETFs that are overbought on every horizon from 2 to 21 days but are not medium or long-term leaders (126d and 252d rank under 65). It collects the snap-back plus the daily-reset decay of the leveraged product.
strategies.entry: Limit short at T+1 open + 0.5 ATR. Filters: 2/5/10/21d ranks above 85 (21d for 3 consecutive days), 126d and 252d ranks under 65. Consecutive-day signals stack additional full-size legs.
strategies.exit: No stop, no target. 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 40 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 1.27 = 76.2 effective. No fragility band. The per-strategy cap of 250 bps/day is the only bound on a stack, and it sees same-day staged risk, not open legs.
strategies.risk_controls: Two-day clock, leader exclusion, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Bear-equity names moved to the 3x Bear ETF Overbot Fade on 2026-07-07. Live since is approximate.

strategies.name: 3x Bear ETF Overbot Fade
strategies.instruments: Bear-equity 3x leveraged ETFs
strategies.captures: Fading an overbought inverse-equity 3x ETF is a long-market dip-buy plus a volatility-drag harvest. It uses looser thresholds than the parent fade on the 13 bear-equity names. The 126d/252d under-65 leader exclusion keeps it from shorting a sustained bear market.
strategies.entry: Limit short at T+1 open + 0.5 ATR. Filters: 2/5/10/21d ranks above 80, 126d and 252d ranks under 65. Consecutive-day signals stack additional legs.
strategies.exit: No stop, no target. 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 25 bps nominal = 37.5 effective. Carries the FAMILY4 band by family analogy: the P/C fear table applies (fear ON 1.25x below dial 50 and 1.0x at 50+, fear OFF 1.0x and 0x), and the plain 0.25x at 50+ applies only when P/C is stale. Same-day signal de-rate: each signal sizes at max(0.30, 1 - 0.10 x (n - 1)), where n is the day's signal count. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Fragility band, P/C fear table, same-day de-rate, leader exclusion, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Every signal in this configuration lands in 2020 or later, a one-regime sample, which is why it runs at 25 bps nominal.

strategies.name: 3x Leader Gap Fade
strategies.instruments: 3x leveraged ETFs: bear-equity, TMF/TMV and commodity names (bull-equity excluded)
strategies.captures: Capitulation fade on 3x ETFs whose underlying is spiking on fear: 252d rank above 95, short-horizon overbought, and still gapping up at the next open. The demanding entry is the risk control in place of a stop.
strategies.entry: Gate: T+1 open above signal close + 0.25 ATR, resolved live by order_staging and fail-closed. Limit short at T+1 open + 0.75 ATR. Filters: 2/5/10/21d ranks above 80, 252d rank above 95. One position per ticker.
strategies.exit: No stop (stops of 1.0 to 2.0 ATR all destroyed the edge in testing). 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 25 bps nominal = 37.5 effective. Exempt from fragility bands and the same-day de-rate on purpose. The per-strategy cap of 250 bps/day bounds the tail.
strategies.risk_controls: Open-gap gate, deep entry limit, two-day clock, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Validation 2026-07-10: 31 trades in 15 episodes 2011-2025, avgR +0.80, PF 2.82, episode-clustered t 2.17. Pilot conviction; 40 bps only after clean out-of-sample quarters. Do not re-add bull-equity names or a stop.

strategies.name: Indices Oversold Bounce
strategies.instruments: SPY and QQQ (signals read on ^GSPC and ^NDX)
strategies.captures: Short-horizon oversold bounce on the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100: 2d rank under 25, a close in the bottom 15% of the range, a decisive down day and a supportive 5d seasonal. Detection runs on the spot indices; orders go to SPY and QQQ.
strategies.entry: Persistent limit at signal close - 0.25 ATR on SPY/QQQ, with ATR and close recomputed on the ETF.
strategies.exit: No stop. 2.0 ATR target or a 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 35 bps nominal = 52.5 effective. FAMILY4 band with the P/C fear table (fear ON 1.25x below dial 50 and 1.0x at 50+, fear OFF 1.0x and 0x); the plain 0.25x at 50+ applies only when P/C is stale. When SPY QQQ MonFri Reversion fires the same ticker the same day, both sides are clamped to 20 nominal = 30 effective. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: Two-day clock, fragility band, P/C fear table, overlap clamp, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.name: SPY QQQ MonFri Reversion
strategies.instruments: SPY and QQQ
strategies.captures: Mean reversion in SPY and QQQ after a close in the bottom 15% of the day's range, on Mondays and Fridays only, with VIX at 13 or higher. The time exit carries the edge; the stop and target roughly cancel.
strategies.entry: Limit at T+1 open - 0.25 ATR. Friday signals are dropped when T+1 gaps up more than 0.5 ATR.
strategies.exit: 1.0 ATR stop (arms day 2), 2.0 ATR target, or a 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 35 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 1.30 = 68.25 effective. FAMILY4 band with the P/C fear table (fear ON 1.25x below dial 50 and 1.0x at 50+, fear OFF 1.0x and 0x); the plain 0.25x at 50+ applies only when P/C is stale. Half size when the T+1 open gaps up more than 0.25 ATR (applied at the open by order_staging). Overlap clamp with Indices Oversold Bounce: 30 effective. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.

strategies.notes: Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.instruments: US sector and index ETFs
strategies.captures: Momentum continuation in sector and index ETFs on the first new 52-week high in 21 days, when the ETF is also a cross-sectional leader (252d rank above 85 across the group). A long-tail position trade: low win rate, large winners.
strategies.entry: Persistent GTC limit at signal close - 0.5 ATR, live 10 trading days. 252d rank 65-90.
strategies.exit: 1.0 ATR stop (arms day 2), 8.0 ATR target, or a 63 trading-day time stop.
strategies.sizing: 25 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 0.87 = 32.6 effective. No fragility band. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.

strategies.instruments: IWM, DIA, SMH
strategies.captures: Monday-only oversold bounce in IWM, DIA and SMH: 2d rank under 50, a close in the bottom 15% of the range, above the 200d SMA for 15 sessions, VIX at 13 or higher. SPY and QQQ are carved out to MonFri Reversion so the two never overlap.

strategies.exit: 1.0 ATR stop (arms day 2), 2.0 ATR target, or a 2 trading-day time exit.

strategies.name: ATR Extended Gap Up
strategies.instruments: US large/mid-cap stocks and commodity ETFs, plus the overflow tier
strategies.captures: Shorts parabolic extensions: more than 10 ATR above the 50d SMA on volume above 2x the 63d average, followed by another gap up of more than 0.5 ATR at the next open. Extension, a volume climax and a final gap read as a blow-off top.
strategies.entry: Limit short at T+1 open + 0.75 ATR, only after the T+1 gap confirms. Takes precedence over OVS on the same symbol.
strategies.exit: No stop. 4.0 ATR target or a 2 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 40 bps nominal x 1.5 x tilt 1.10 = 66 effective. No fragility band. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.

strategies.notes: Live since is approximate (book live in Primary around June 2026).

strategies.name: Monthly Weak Close
strategies.instruments: SPY and QQQ
strategies.captures: A month that closes in the bottom 15% of its own high-low range while the ETF is above its 200d SMA. In a bull regime that marks a capitulative month-end, and the reversion plays out over the following week. The 200d gate is load-bearing: ungated signals ride bear legs down.
strategies.entry: Signal on the month's last trading day. Persistent limit at signal close - 0.25 ATR, live T+1 to T+2. Fills about half the signals.
strategies.exit: No stop (1.0 ATR is the sizing unit only). 2.0 ATR target or a 5 trading-day time exit.
strategies.sizing: 30 bps nominal = 45 effective. FAMILY4 band by analogy, with the P/C fear table (fear ON 1.25x below dial 50 and 1.0x at 50+, fear OFF 1.0x and 0x); the plain 0.25x at 50+ applies only when P/C is stale. Per-strategy cap 250 bps/day.
strategies.risk_controls: 200d trend gate, five-day clock, fragility band, P/C fear table, per-strategy daily cap.
strategies.notes: About 1.1 signals a year; SPY and QQQ signals in the same month are near-duplicates. Small sample: the limit-entry research cell was 15 fills.

strategies.name: Open Breakout (NQ/ES)
strategies.instruments: MNQ and MES micro futures (signals from NQ and ES)
strategies.captures: Trades the first move away from the 09:30 open in Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 futures once price travels 25% of the previous full session's true range. The idea is that a real opening move tends to keep going into the afternoon, so the trade holds to 15:55 unless the stop is hit.
strategies.entry: Enter on a cross of open +/- 25% of the previous full CME session true range, before 11:30 ET, at most three attempts per market per day and one position at a time. Shorts only when the previous cash session's legacy 63d risk score (10-observation average) is 20 or higher; no long filter. Prior-range skip filter: a market sits out the session when the previous session's true range divided by its prior 20-session average is 1.25 or higher (fails closed when the average cannot be computed).
strategies.exit: Initial stop 25% of the prior true range from the average fill. No break-even move, trailing stop or target. Timed market exit at 15:55 ET.
strategies.sizing: Live pilot: 1 MNQ and 1 MES contract, capped at one contract per market in both code and config. The runner first sizes from a per-trade risk budget of 15 bps NQ / 10 bps ES on the $750k basis (25 bps open-risk and 75 bps daily caps; not GRM-scaled), then applies the one-contract cap; a computed size of 0 means no trade. The research replay risks 100 bps per trade for comparability only.
strategies.risk_controls: One-contract cap behind layered live guards, stop from the fill, three-attempt cap, 11:30 entry cutoff, short gate, prior-range skip, dedicated client IDs and contracts, preflight before 09:25.

frozen_stats.notes: Headline is NQ and ES combined at base costs, unfiltered current candidate (break-even off). Profit factor is on R. Sharpe is per market from the 100 bps compounded replay (see cases). Computed from current_candidate/{NQ,ES}_{base,stress}_trades.csv.

strategies.notes: ES at stress costs (4-tick slippage) loses money: 1602 trades, 32.0% win rate, mean -0.134R, PF 0.82 on R, Sharpe -1.08, and a 90% drawdown in the compounded replay. ES is thin even at base costs (+0.096R). The prior-range filter shipped on an owner override ahead of its pre-registered forward test (prereg 2026-09-25; RTY cross-check NEUTRAL); in sample it skips about 21-22% of traded days, and the stats here are the unfiltered candidate. The 2026-09-25 launch never happened (Gateway outage); 2026-09-28 is the first staged live session.

strategies.name: Legend EMA
strategies.instruments: SPY and QQQ
strategies.captures: After a session with a strong one-way bar (body at least 75% of the day's range) whose 15-minute bars never touched their 20-period EMA, the next open tends to reach back toward that EMA in the first hour. The trade buys an open that sits below the EMA and targets a penny under it.
strategies.entry: Per ETF: the prior session qualifies if |close - open| / (high - low) >= 0.75 and no 15-minute bar touched its EMA20, and it must be a full session. At 09:31, if the 09:30 open is below the EMA reference, buy at market. Rejected if the 09:30 bar already touched the target. Ex-dividend days are skipped through a configured skip-date list. Long only; shorts are off by owner decision (2026-09-23).
strategies.exit: Target limit at the EMA minus $0.01, revised at 09:46, 10:01 and 10:16 as completed 15-minute bars extend the EMA; otherwise a market exit at 10:30. No stop. A 10:32 check trades any residual of the quantity entered back to flat.
strategies.sizing: 40 percent of NAV for SPY and 30 percent for QQQ, capped by MAX_SHARES. Shares = floor(NLV x pct / decision price), with NLV read live from the Primary account rather than the $750k book basis. MAX_SHARES is a fat-finger ceiling, not the size, and the code refuses any cap above its own hard ceiling.
strategies.risk_controls: No stop; the 10:30 time exit bounds the hold. Share-cap ceiling, refusal when NLV is missing or non-finite, activation flag, append-only journal for idempotence. It runs independently of the systematic book: another book's position or order in SPY or QQQ does not block an entry, and it refuses only when its own orderRef or journal already shows today's entry. Exits and the 10:32 check net only its own executions.

frozen_stats.notes: Long side of the Databento futures-signal backtest executed in the ETFs (primary variant, ex-dividend days excluded, net of 2 bps round trip). ES signal to SPY: 28 trades, 57.1% win, +19.6 bps average, PF 3.24, date-clustered t 1.20. NQ signal to QQQ: 45 trades, 64.4% win, +12.5 bps, PF 1.81, t 1.49. No R multiple because there is no stop.

strategies.notes: Started on 2026-09-23 with MAX_SHARES set to one share while the exit-sizing fixes in docs/briefs/2026-09-23/legend_ema_size_fixes.md were open; since 2026-09-24 the cap is a fat-finger ceiling and the NAV percentages set the size. Neither long cell is individually significant (t 1.2 and 1.5). The runner is legend_ema.py in trading_ibkr, not this repo. Source: artifacts/legend-etf-execution-backtest-20260901/.

strategies.name: Trend Sleeve
strategies.instruments: 12 ETFs: SPY QQQ IWM EFA EEM FXI VNQ GLD SLV DBC TLT LQD
strategies.captures: Monthly trend-following ballast across equities, real estate, commodities and bonds. It is there to add a return stream with low correlation to the book (about +0.12), not to add per-trade edge.
strategies.entry: On the month's last trading day an ETF is held when its 12-1 month momentum is positive and it closes above its 10-month SMA. trend_sleeve.py writes MOO rows for the next session, but the pre-market true-MOO runner (trend_moo.py) is not activated, so order_staging's legacy path submits them as market orders with TIF DAY at about 09:31. Changes under 1% of sleeve NAV are skipped unless the signal flips.
strategies.exit: Positions unwind at the next monthly rebalance when an ETF fails the signal. No stops.
strategies.sizing: 30% of the $750k basis deployed (cut from 60% on 2026-07-17). Inverse-volatility weights across eligible ETFs, each slot capped at 20%; unused slots sit in cash. Not GRM-scaled.
strategies.risk_controls: 20% slot cap, rebalance band, and in the current code a month-entry fragility gate: the whole sleeve stays in cash when the latest month-end 10d MA of the 63d dial is above 50 (fails closed on a missing or stale dial).

frozen_stats.notes: Expected figures from the trend_sleeve.py spec on the next-open basis for this 12-ETF universe, not a trade-level backtest. Trades per year counts monthly rebalances.

strategies.notes: Ballast only; it loses about 0.4% a month in high-fragility months. No USO (roll decay) and no UUP (capital inefficiency). Scale-up only after 2 clean quarters. If staged orders never execute, the R2 state must be cleared or the next rebalance deltas are wrong. Note that docs/claude_ref/fragility_dial.md lists a "trend-sleeve gate" among rejected proposals, while trend_sleeve.py runs the dial cash gate described under risk controls.

strategies.name: Event Sleeve
strategies.instruments: SPY, IWM, SVXY
strategies.captures: Calendar-anchored index trades around scheduled events: the pre-FOMC drift, post-opex windows in September and December, and short-volatility carry after monthly options expiration. Each window was pre-registered on 2026-08-06 with its evidence and kill rule before going live.
strategies.entry: Staged by event_sleeve.py in the AM job and placed by event_moo.py as market-on-open or native market-on-close parent orders on the Primary account. Window rules are listed per component.
strategies.exit: State-driven exits on a scheduled date, market-on-close or market-on-open. No stops and no dial conditioning, by design.
strategies.sizing: Percent of the fixed $750k ACCOUNT_VALUE in notional, not live NLV and not GRM-scaled: T1 25%, T2 10%, T3 15%, T4 25%, V2 5%, V4 10%. event_moo caps a day's basket at 3 rows and $350k notional.
strategies.risk_controls: Per-trade kill rules from the prereg (cumulative NAV loss or consecutive losers), a SPY 21d rank filter on T2, a washout skip on T3, universe limited to SPY, IWM and SVXY, fail-closed basket validation.

frozen_stats.notes: Roughly 16 windows in a midterm year and 22 in other years, from the prereg's expected counts. Per-component evidence is a verbatim transcription of event_sleeve.BACKTEST_EVIDENCE, never recomputed.

components.name: FOMC drift
components.window: MOC 4 sessions before a scheduled FOMC decision to MOO on decision day; non-midterm years only

components.name: FOMC midterm short
components.window: Same FOMC window in midterm years, only when the SPY 21d return rank (252d, lag-1) is under 50

components.name: September post-quad short
components.window: September opex MOC to the last September session MOC; skipped when IWM z10 (lag-1) is under -1

components.name: December post-opex long
components.window: December opex MOC to year-end MOC

components.name: Nov-Dec short vol
components.window: First November session MOC to year-end MOC; non-midterm years only

components.name: Post-opex short vol
components.window: Every monthly opex MOC to +3 sessions MOC, except September and while V2 holds
components.span: all monthly opex ex-Sep, synthetic -0.5x validated 0.9967 vs real; hit rate is the 2021-06+ era

strategies.notes: First live fill: V4 SVXY on 2026-08-21. 2026 is a midterm year, so T1 and V2 are inactive and T2 is the FOMC leg. The orderRef strategy field is the trade id.

strategies.name: Daily Pitch
strategies.instruments: US-listed equities and ETFs
strategies.captures: Up to three one-off trade ideas each morning, invented from repo context and falsified by adversarial checks before delivery. Deliberately not systematic: each idea is a judgement call that carries its own evidence.
strategies.entry: Closed vocabulary: MOO, MOC, or a limit anchored to a price with a k-ATR offset. Nothing places without an exact Y on the Pitch tab (pitch_moo.py at 9:05 and 9:32), or a hand-staged order from the site Pitch tab, which counts as approved once it fills.
strategies.exit: Every idea carries a time stop in trading days, with an optional ATR target and stop.
strategies.sizing: ATR-risk sanity bounds, never notional: 60 bps per idea and 150 bps per day, plus the runner's approved-basket limit. ATR here is Wilder-14, not the book's simple mean.
strategies.risk_controls: Grammar validation in pitch_grammar.py, at most one grade C idea, mandatory time stop, activation flag on the runner, pessimistic grading of declined ideas too.
strategies.notes: Graded daily into data/pitch_journal.jsonl and data/pitch_scoreboard.json. The orderRef strategy is Pitch-<idea id>, matched here by prefix.

strategies.name: Seasonal Board Tickets
strategies.instruments: US stocks and ETFs on the site Seasonal tab
strategies.captures: A daily board of seasonal setups graded A and B, filtered by a cycle-win gate and an extension gate. Each card can prefill an Execution ticket; trading it is a manual decision.
strategies.entry: Ticket prefill at the card price, with the stop, target and time stop derived from the seasonal window.
strategies.exit: Stop at 1.0 / 1.3 / 1.6 ATR for 5 / 10 / 21-day windows, a 2:1 target, or the window's time stop.
strategies.sizing: Manual convention of 30 bps risk per trade; the Execution tab fills quantity from the selected account's live NLV.
strategies.risk_controls: Bracket stop and time stop on every ticket.
strategies.notes: Tickets carry whatever strategy name is typed on the Execution ticket (blank means Discretionary), so live fills cannot be attributed to the board automatically. Board gates redesigned 2026-07-24; the first live date is not recorded.

strategies.name: Momentum Radar
strategies.instruments: US stocks from the weekly momentum radar screen
strategies.captures: Weekly momentum plans from the separate radar-briefings repo (weekend screen plus a cloud agent). This repo only transports them: the Radar tab stages the engine's plans, and radar_trail_sync.py moves live stops to the radar's weekly trail.
strategies.entry: Staged from the Radar tab into an Execution entry bracket on the Primary account, using the engine's own prices and share counts unchanged.
strategies.exit: Stop legs trail weekly to the level the radar engine publishes; radar_trail_sync.py applies it after the upload step.
strategies.sizing: The engine sizes against its own $250,000 book. A plan's bps are bps of that book, not of live NLV (36 bps there is about 14 bps of Primary). Never rescaled here.
strategies.risk_controls: Primary only, staging blocked on a plan older than 10 days, field whitelist, refusals instead of derived numbers.
strategies.notes: Radar numbers come from book_update.py in radar-briefings and are never recomputed, rounded or rescaled on this side.
